name: Qutwo
description: Qutwo is a Helsinki-based quantum-AI orchestration company that routes enterprise workloads across classical, quantum-inspired, and quantum hardware through its Qutwo OS platform. Founded in February 2026 by Peter Sarlin (former Silo AI CEO) and co-founders from IQM Quantum Computers and Silo AI, the company targets enterprise AI and optimization use cases that will migrate to quantum hardware as the technology matures.

products.name: Qutwo OS
products.description: Orchestration layer that routes AI and optimization workloads across classical, quantum-inspired, and quantum hardware based on task requirements and hardware availability

highlights: Founded by Peter Sarlin, who sold Silo AI to AMD for $665M in 2024, with co-founders from IQM Quantum Computers and Silo AI
Raised EUR 25M angel round in May 2026 at EUR 325M valuation, backed by Yuri Milner, Xavier Niel, and Niklas Zennstrom
Secured over EUR 20M in contracted revenue within two months of launch through partnerships with Zalando and OP Pohjola

news.title: Qutwo raises EUR 25M angel round at EUR 325M valuation to bridge enterprise AI and quantum computing
news.excerpt: Helsinki-based Qutwo, founded by Silo AI CEO Peter Sarlin with co-founders from IQM and Silo AI, raised EUR 25M from Yuri Milner, Xavier Niel, and Niklas Zennstrom. The company has already secured EUR 20M in contracted revenue through design partnerships with Zalando and OP Pohjola.
